a.lede: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”
a.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation

b.lede: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
b.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
